questions.q: Please put both ___ under the table.
questions.e: both 指两个，box 以 x 结尾，复数加 es，不能只加 s。

questions.q: Two ___ work here at night.
questions.e: two 后要用复数。man 变 men，不能在两种词形后加 s。

questions.q: We have one long day and two short ___ this week.
questions.e: day 的 y 前是元音字母 a，复数保留 y，只加 s。

questions.q: We need both buses today. One ___ is for the students.
questions.e: 从已提到的两辆车里选一辆，用 of the buses，bus 是单数。

questions.q: One of my friends ___ the night bus every day.
questions.e: 主语中心是 one，习惯动作用 takes。friends 不决定谓语形式。

questions.q: This little tree has only three ___.
questions.e: three 后用复数。把 leaf 末尾的 f 改成 ves，不能直接加 s。

questions.q: This program is for two ___ (family).
a: families
questions.e: two 后要用复数。family 的 y 前是辅音字母 l，要把 y 改成 i 再加 es，不能直接加 s。

questions.q: I can see three ___ (mouse) in the photo.
a: mice
questions.e: three 后要用复数。mouse 的复数是 mice，不能按一般规则写成 mouses。

questions.zh: 这两栋房子里，有一栋离学校很远。
a: One of these two houses is far from the school.
One of the two houses is far from the school.
questions.e: 用 one of 从两栋房子中选一栋。two 后写 houses，谓语跟着 one，写 is。far from 表示离某处远。

a: Both buses are late.
The two buses are both late.
questions.e: bus 以 s 结尾，复数加 es。both 可以放在 buses 前，也可以放在 are 后，谓语仍用 are。

questions.a: I want to read one of your books.
questions.e: 先排出 want to read，再把 one of your books 放在 read 后作宾语。of 后是作为一组的书，所以 books 要用复数。

questions.a: We provide services for lots of people.
questions.e: services 指提供的多种服务，要写复数。lots of 表示许多，people 已是复数，别再加 s。

questions.q: We need ___ for the new house.
questions.e: furniture 是不可数名词，不能加 s，也不能直接用 a 或数字。

questions.q: We need two ___ of information: the time and the place.
questions.e: information 不可数，two 数的是 pieces，复数不用撇号。

questions.q: We can play a game after we do ___.
questions.e: homework 不可数，可以加 our，不能加 s、a 或直接加数字。

questions.q: How ___ games can we play before lunch?
questions.e: games 是可数复数，问数量用 How many。much 问不可数量。

questions.q: There isn't ___ water in this glass.
questions.e: 否定句可用 much 修饰不可数的 water，其余选项修饰可数复数。

questions.q: I have ___ news for you.
questions.e: 肯定句用 some 表示有些，any 常用于否定句。news 不可数。

questions.q: Please bring me two ___ (glass) of water.
a: glasses
questions.e: water 不可数，这里数的是杯子。glass 以 s 结尾，复数加 es，别把复数加在 water 上。

questions.q: There aren't ___ books in this box at all. (Use 'some' or 'any'.)
a: any
questions.e: aren't 和 at all 表示一本书也没有，用 any。some 通常用在肯定句里表示有一些。

questions.zh: 我父亲能给你两条建议。
a: My father can give you two pieces of advice.
My father can give two pieces of advice to you.
questions.e: advice 不可数，给建议计数时用 two pieces of advice。you 可以紧跟 give，或放在句末用 to 引出。

a: How many hours do you work every day?
How many hours a day do you work?
questions.e: 这里问的是几个小时。hour 可数，要用 How many hours，不能用 How much hours。

questions.a: How much money do you need for the bus?
questions.zh: 你坐公交车需要多少钱？
questions.e: money 不可数，把 How much money 整体放在句首，再接 do you need。别把 money 拆到 need 后面。

questions.a: I often listen to music at night.
questions.e: 写出 listen to 里的 to。music 在这里指音乐，不可数，不能写成 musics。

questions.q: Can I have ___ before I go to work?
o: an apple and a glass of water
a apple and a glass of water
an apple and an glass of water
a apple and an glass of water
questions.e: apple 以元音音素开头，用 an。glass 以 /ɡ/ 开头，用 a。

questions.q: You don't need to come back, so buy ___.
questions.e: one-way 以 /w/ 开头，用 a。单数 ticket 需要限定词。

questions.q: You need ___ for this job.
questions.e: MBA 的 M 读 /em/，开头是元音。an 后用单数 MBA。

questions.q: The city is far from here, but we can get there ___ in an hour.
questions.e: 表示交通方式时用 by car，car 前不加冠词。

questions.q: Can you ___? We have time for one game.
questions.e: chess 在这里指棋类活动。play chess 中不加冠词。

questions.q: I can't sleep well ___.
questions.e: at night 是固定搭配，表示在夜里，night 前不加冠词。

questions.q: I need ___ uniform for my new job. (Use 'a' or 'an'.)
a: a
questions.e: uniform 的首字母是 u，开头读的却是辅音 /j/，因此用 a。按首字母写 an 会出错。

questions.q: Do you often have ___ at home or at school? (Use 'lunch', 'a lunch' or 'the lunch'.)
a: lunch
questions.e: 这里问平时在哪里吃午饭，直接说 have lunch。说某一顿特定的午饭时才需要用 the lunch。

questions.zh: 午饭后我们有一个小时。
a: We have an hour after lunch.
We have one hour after lunch.
After lunch, we have an hour.
questions.e: hour 的 h 不发音，因此说 an hour。也可用 one 表示数量。after lunch 说的是用餐时间，lunch 前不加冠词。

a: My father studies English at home.
At home, my father studies English.
questions.e: English 是语言名，前面不加 the。at home 表示在家，home 前也不加冠词。
can 后接动词原形 meet，时间放在后面。after dinner 指吃完晚饭以后，dinner 前不用加冠词。

questions.a: I meet a friend for lunch every week.
questions.e: friend 的开头是辅音 /f/，前面有 a。for lunch 里的 lunch 是餐名，直接写。

questions.q: My father is at the station now. We can meet ___ there.
questions.e: 见面对象作 meet 的宾语，用 him。he 是主格，his 表所属。

questions.q: Can our teacher come with you and ___?
questions.e: you 和 me 都跟在介词 with 后。这里用宾格 me，不能用主格 I。

questions.q: ___ want to learn more about this city.
questions.e: want 前缺主语，用 We。Us 是宾格，We're 会多出一个 are。

questions.q: I know where my books are. Do you know where ___ are?
questions.e: yours 指你的书。your 要接名词，you're 已含 are。

questions.q: This company provides a good service, but I don't know ___ name.
questions.e: its name 指这家公司的名字。it's 含有动词，不能用来修饰名词。

questions.q: We can meet in ___ room. It is big.
questions.e: room 前需要 our 表所属。ours 单独用，we 和 us 不表所属。

questions.q: We need help. Can you show ___ (we) the way?
a: us
questions.e: show 后面先接接受帮助的人，再接 the way。这里的人是动作的对象，所以 we 要变成 us。

questions.q: The big room is our room. The small room is ___ (they).
a: theirs
questions.e: 空后没有名词，用 theirs 代替 their room。their 后要接名词，them 只作宾格。

questions.zh: 她可以和我一起去学校。
a: She can go to school with me.
She can go with me to school.
questions.e: 句首的她是主语，用 She。跟在介词 with 后的我要用宾格 me，不能写 with I。

questions.zh: 我的一个朋友在这家公司工作。
a: A friend of mine works at this company.
One of my friends works for this company.
questions.e: a friend of 后用 mine，不能用 my。也可说 one of my friends，这时 my 后接复数名词。
一般疑问句先用 Do you know，再接宾语 their names。their 修饰 names，不能把两词倒过来。

questions.a: I can do the work by myself.
questions.e: by myself 表示独自完成，和主语 I 对应。不要写成 by me，也别把 myself 拆开。

questions.q: I have two maps here. Can we use ___ maps to find the city?
questions.e: here 指身边，maps 是复数，选 these。those 指较远处。

questions.q: Can you see ___ car over there?
questions.e: over there 指远处，car 是单数，用 that。this 指近处。

questions.q: We have one dog. ___ name is Max.
questions.e: 只有一只狗，dog 后加 's。dogs' 是复数所有格。

questions.q: All four ___ books are on this table.
questions.e: four 对应复数 students。词尾已有 s，表示所属时只加撇号。

questions.q: Two women are here for their bags. Please put both ___ bags in the car.
questions.e: 两位女士用 women。词尾没有 s，所有格加 's。

questions.q: I need the books over there. Can you bring ___ to me?
questions.e: 远处的几本书用 those 指代。these 指近处，that 是单数。

questions.q: Look at ___ photo in my hand. (Use 'this', 'that', 'these' or 'those'.)
a: this
questions.e: 照片在说话人手里，而且只有一张，用近处单数 this。these 指多张，that 指较远处。

questions.q: The front ___ the car is black, but the back is white.
a: of
questions.e: the front of the car 表示汽车的前部。把部位放在 of 前，整体放在 of 后。from 表示来源，放在这里不能表达所属。

a: Do you want to use this pen?
Would you like to use this pen?
questions.e: 用 this 指近处的一支笔。those 指远处的多个物品，these 也得和复数名词搭配。

a: Those books are the children's.
Those are the children's books.
questions.e: those 指远处的多本书。children 已是复数，词尾没有 s，所有格要加 's，不能写成 childrens'。

questions.a: I like the end of this story.
questions.zh: 我喜欢这个故事的结尾。
questions.e: 先排 I like，再接喜欢的事物 the end of this story。the end 在 of 前，this story 在 of 后，顺序不能颠倒。

questions.a: Both teams' names are on the board.
questions.e: both 指两支队，teams 是复数。撇号放在 s 后面，teams' names 表示两支队各自的名字。
